description: The spaceSpacious five-bedroom luxury home on Avenue Foch, Paris 16th arrondissement. 326 m² across four floors, sleeps up to fourteen guests. Steps from the Arc de Triomphe, Champs-Élysées and Trocadéro. Ideal for families, groups or corporate stays in one of Paris's most prestigious addresses.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSFive individually appointed bedrooms with five double beds. Four additional guests may be accommodated on two double sofa-bed, located in one of the bedrooms and in the living room. Generous room sizes throughout, with elegant interiors and ample storage. Comfortable accommodation for large families or multiple couples travelling together.BATHROOMSThree full bathrooms, two of them an-suites each with separate shower and toilet, plus an additional separate WC. Fresh towels and quality fittings ensure a comfortable stay for all guests.KITCHEN AND LIVING SPACESA fully equipped separate kitchen with modern appliances and plenty of workspace for preparing meals at home. Bright living and dining areas perfect for gathering together after a day exploring Paris.PRIME PARIS 16TH LOCATIONAvenue Foch connects the Arc de Triomphe to the Bois de Boulogne, placing you in one of the most sought-after neighbourhoods in Paris. Walk to the Champs-Élysées, Place du Trocadéro and the Eiffel Tower viewpoint. Porte Dauphine metro (Line 2) and Charles de Gaulle-Étoile station (Lines 1, 2, 6 and RER A) are minutes away, giving easy access to the entire city.AMENITIESHigh-speed WiFi, central heating, washing machine, separate kitchen, security cameras and a well-maintained building. Everything you need for a comfortable long or short stay in Paris.PERFECT FORLarge families visiting Paris, group holidays, corporate retreats or celebrations. With five bedrooms, three and a half bathroo
